No self-hosted runner pool is declared in infra/ci/runners.yaml, and none may be invented. HB-I7 owns it (self-hosted CI runners — 175 issues x a 35-60 min PR gate is 100-175 CPU-hours; owner, spend), and HB-L11 is why naming a facility is a decision rather than a lookup: physical residency is not legal residency, and the residency claim files/06 §5 makes about CI has to be one somebody can check. Note what does NOT block this: HB-I5's 'no in-country provider' finding is about GPU supply, and a CI runner needs CPU — files/00_STATE.md §2 records the AWS Istanbul Local Zone as GA with C7i/M7i/R7i, which is this shape exactly. The constraint is the decision and the spend, not capacity. Until a pool exists, CI runs on GitHub-hosted runners, which files/08 §6 records as the fallback exactly because no PHI is ever in CI.
